# cozystack_restore_job (Resource)

A Cozystack RestoreJob: restores a Backup into a tenant application.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cozystack_restore_job" "restore" {
  name        = "restore-app"
  namespace   = "tenant-root"
  backup_name = "daily-20260602030000"

  target_application_ref = {
    api_group = "apps.cozystack.io"
    kind      = "Postgres"
    name      = "app"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backup_name` (String) Name of the Backup to restore.
- `name` (String) RestoreJob name (`metadata.name`). Immutable.
- `namespace` (String) Tenant namespace the application is created in. Immutable.

### Optional

- `options` (String) Driver-specific restore options as JSON.
- `target_application_ref` (Attributes) Application to restore into. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_application_ref))
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Block on create/update until the tenant's `Ready` condition is true.
- `wait_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait when `wait_for_ready` is set (Go duration, e.g. `10m`).

### Read-Only

- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version (`status.version`).
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier in the form `namespace/name`.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application's `Ready` condition is true.
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`). Stable across updates; changes on recreate.

<a id="nestedatt--target_application_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target_application_ref`

Required:

- `kind` (String) Kind of the referenced application.
- `name` (String) Name of the referenced application.

Optional:

- `api_group` (String) API group of the referenced application.
